title: Share video
shareHint: Share the file to an app, or save it for later.
saveHint: Save the file, then attach it to your social post.
finishing: Getting your video ready to share…
progressHint: Keep LoB open until your preview is ready. You can cancel at any time.
invalidRange: Choose a valid starting and ending turn.
tooLarge: This file is too large for an in-browser export. Try fewer turns or 720p.
encoderUnavailable: The video encoder could not load. Check your connection and try again.
exportStalled: The export stopped responding. Please try again.
emptyReplay: There is no battle footage in this range. Choose another turn.
exportFailed: The video could not be created. Try a shorter clip or lower quality.
shareFailed: The file could not be shared. Try saving it and attaching it to your post.
durationHint: Fits all selected turns, the lineup and the battle result into this duration.
invalidDuration: Enter a duration of at least 1 second.
preparingTiming: Fitting the battle into your video’s duration…
takingLonger: This step is taking longer than usual. You can keep waiting or cancel and try a shorter clip.
preparingStart: Finding the start of your clip…
endScreenHint: Adds the winner and stats when the clip reaches the end of a finished battle.
cinematicHint: Hides unit status bars. Camera, sound, turn number and victory points have separate settings.
endUnknown: This replay does not include the winner.
vignetteHint: Gently darkens the edges of the video.
lineupOverBattle: Start the battle during the lineup
lineupOverBattleHint: The rosters sit over the opening moves instead of holding on a still frame.
